name: Bay of Bengal

global_influences.evidence: The band is described as experimental rock/metal built on flute melodies and keyboard-driven arrangements — an instrumentation choice that sits outside the guitar-first template of the Dhaka metal scene.
global_influences.source: Encyclopedic band entry; band's own channel and page descriptions

local_adaptation_notes: Bangla-language, and notable for foregrounding flute — a folk-associated instrument — inside a rock/metal arrangement rather than treating folk material as a separate repertoire.
sound_evolution_summary: Debut album 'Nirob Durvikkho' (2016) with the video for 'Je Sohore Ami Nei'; the flute/keyboard texture is the band's identifying feature across the catalogue.
concert_culture_notes: One of the few Chattogram-formed acts to reach the national festival stage, opening the fifth Joy Bangla Concert (2019) at the Bangladesh Army Stadium.
listener_community_notes: Represents the non-Dhaka side of the rock scene; a useful test case for whether the preference network is a Dhaka network or a national one.

sources.title: Joy Bangla concert 2019 resonates across Dhaka
